name: DynamiCare Rewards
short_description: Smartphone-based contingency management platform for substance use recovery combining financial incentives, remote drug testing, and recovery coaching.
long_description: DynamiCare is a smartphone-delivered digital care program that combines contingency management (financial incentives), remote substance testing, recovery coaching, and evidence-based behavioral content to support people with substance use disorders. The platform enables patients to perform substance tests anytime through connected breath and saliva tests verified by selfie video. Negative tests earn members financial incentives on a smart debit card that blocks access to bars, liquor stores, and cash withdrawals. Features include GPS treatment attendance tracking, scheduling tools, 90+ self-paced coping exercises, and certified CM Guide coaching sessions. DynamiCare is the only company to receive a favorable HHS-OIG advisory opinion for contingency management allowing up to $599 in monetary incentives per patient without Anti-Kickback Statute sanctions.

faqs.a: Patients perform substance tests through the app using connected breath or saliva tests verified by selfie video. Negative tests earn financial incentives on a smart debit card that blocks purchases at bars, liquor stores, and ATM withdrawals.

Yes, DynamiCare is the only company with a favorable HHS-OIG advisory opinion confirming their contingency management program with up to $599 in incentives will not incur sanctions under the federal Anti-Kickback Statute.
